note: Gas Giant: a hungry alien critter held like a shotgun. Feed it space beans (each bean = 'perFood' shells), it fires a fixed spread of gooey pellets from its rear vent. Pellets are real projectiles (speed m/s, gravity m/s^2), damage per pellet with falloff [fullDamageUntil m, minDamageFrom m, minMultiplier]; head/limb multipliers like every gun. Splash: each pellet that hits the world hurts others within splashR metres (linear falloff, the shooter is immune). Pattern: 1 centre pellet + 'inner' pellets on a ring of radius innerR + 'outer' pellets on a ring of radius outerR (radians), the whole pattern rotated randomly per shot, each pellet jittered by 'jitter'. Ported 1:1 by modules/w_poopgun.js.

weapon.name: Gas Giant
weapon.desc: A hungry space critter. Feed it beans, point its rear end, squeeze: nine gooey blobs. Two-shots anyone up to 10 m, splashes on walls.
